data.name: Infernal Dash
data.detailed_description:
Imagine Geometry Dash, but in 3D, with Death chasing you.

It's a runner where every run is its own little story. You're not just sprinting — you're trying to outsmart time and outrun the inevitable. And yes, you'll fail sometimes, but every death teaches you something. You remember where you slipped, you come back, and you get faster, sharper.

What to expect:

  • 90 seconds is just a benchmark. Sometimes you can blast through a level in half a minute if you risk the shortcut. Other times you might hang around for a couple minutes, grabbing bonuses and poking into hidden alleys. Time is both your friend and your enemy.

  • Three ways to move. Run, Fly, and Aerial Skate. The last one is a whole different beast — you're not just riding, you're gliding above the ground, shifting your path, owning the air.

  • Boosts that aren't free. Every power-up gives you an edge, but always demands something in return. Want to go faster? Control gets trickier. Want invisibility? You'll lose your sense of direction. Choose wisely — the obvious choice isn't always the smart one.

  • Build your own worlds. If you get tired of playing other people's levels, there's an editor (it's a separate DLC). You can craft anything from chill, beautiful landscapes to absolute torture for your friends. And yes, you have to beat your own creation first — that's our rule.

  • Prove it — to yourself and others. Leaderboards, replays, statistics — everything you need to measure your progress and compare with others. And it's honest: any record can be verified, because we store your actual inputs, not just a video.

  • Guilds are for your people. Create a clan, invite friends, track each other's achievements, tackle tough levels together. It's more fun to discuss tactics and show off your creations with others.

  • Community goes beyond the game. We've got a website and a companion app to keep you connected with other players wherever you are. Share levels, see what others are making, get feedback — it's part of the project's life.

Infernal Dash isn't trying to please everyone. But if you want to prove to yourself that you can be faster than time, create something beautiful and challenging, and be part of a living community — you're welcome here. Run, build, prove.
